title: 29 July 1952: Newsreel on DC UFO flap
note: Period newsreel covering the July 1952 radar contacts over Washington National Airport, when jets were scrambled and the story reached the front pages.

title: March 13, 1997 Phoenix, Arizona UFO Lights - ORIGINAL VIDEO
note: Home-video footage of the Phoenix Lights: a formation of lights drifting slowly over the city, seen by thousands across Arizona.

title: Rendlesham Forest UFO sighting: Eyewitness Colonel Charles Halt
note: Deputy base commander Charles Halt describes the December 1980 events outside RAF Bentwaters, including the recording made in the forest that night.

title: JAL Flight 1628 UFO over Alaska, 1986
note: Captain Kenju Terauchi's Japan Air Lines cargo flight was tracked on radar while a large object paced the aircraft over Alaska.

title: The Belgium UFO That Defied Physics
note: During the Belgian wave, F-16s were scrambled and locked radar on a target that made sudden altitude changes no aircraft could follow.

title: Pentagon declassifies leaked 'UFO' videos
note: The 'Tic Tac' FLIR clip from the 2004 Nimitz carrier group exercises — one of three videos the Pentagon later confirmed as genuine.

title: FAA audio of UFO over Chicago O'Hare Airport
note: A disc-shaped object reportedly hovered over gate C17 before shooting upward through cloud, leaving a hole in the overcast. United and FAA staff gave accounts.

title: Stephenville, Texas UFO sighting — CNN report
channel: Red Panda Koala's UFO History Archive
note: Dozens of residents reported a large silent object with flashing lights crossing the sky; radar later showed an unexplained return.

title: UFO in Turkey takes witnesses by surprise
note: A night watchman filmed disc-shaped objects over the Sea of Marmara across several nights; the clips were examined by Turkish UFO researchers.

title: 2013 Aguadilla, Puerto Rico UAP/USO
note: US Customs aircraft infrared footage of an object that crossed the airfield, entered the water and appeared to split in two. Later analysed in a published SCU report.

title: Chilean Navy releases video of mysterious flying object
note: Chile's CEFAA study group released navy infrared footage of an object that emitted a plume and vanished, after finding no conventional explanation.

title: Gimbal: the first officially released UAP footage
note: Super Hornet targeting footage from 2015 showing an object that appears to rotate against the wind; released with the other two Navy clips.

title: UFO caught on camera by USS Omaha
note: Night-vision footage from the USS Omaha of a sphere-like object over the water; radar reportedly tracked a swarm of them.

title: Mysterious drones over New Jersey caught on camera
note: The winter 2024 flap: repeated large drone-like lights over New Jersey and the US north-east, prompting federal briefings without a settled answer.

title: The Calvine UFO Incident - part 1
note: Two men walking near Calvine photographed a large diamond-shaped object with a jet circling it. The negatives went to the Ministry of Defence and vanished for thirty years.

title: The Rendlesham Forest incident: the Halt Tape
note: The unedited cassette Lt. Col. Charles Halt recorded in the forest on the second night, with radiation readings and lights reported in real time.

title: USAF UK Bases Flooded With Sightings: What’s REALLY Happening?
note: Geeksvana examines reports of UAP sightings around USAF bases in the UK, including RAF Lakenheath and RAF Mildenhall, during the November 2024 drone/UAP flap. The claims remain unverified.

title: UFO SPOTTED at Manchester Airport! What's Going On?
note: Commentary on a viral report of a spherical object near Manchester Airport. The footage and its interpretation are unverified.

title: UFO caught on camera 'travelling 106mph' in Wales as UK gov urged to come clean
note: The Sun reports on footage said to show an object travelling at 106 mph over South Wales, amid calls for the UK government to release UAP data. The object's identity is unresolved.

title: UFO sighting over Wales, UK 2018. video taken on an infra red camera.
note: Infrared camera footage said to show a luminous object over North Wales in 2018. The clip is presented as a UAP; no independent identification is available.

title: WATCH: Tic Tac UFO seen Hovering Over Scotland! #ufo #shorts
note: Short clip described as a Tic Tac-shaped object over the Scottish Highlands. The footage is unverified.

title: The Town with the Most UFO Sightings in the World
note: Short documentary visit to Bonnybridge, the Scottish town at the centre of the Falkirk Triangle and decades of UFO reports. Includes local accounts and case history; claims are unverified.

title: Police helicopter captures UFO
note: South Wales Police helicopter thermal footage filmed 1,000 ft over the Bristol Channel, showing a bright spherical object moving against the wind. The object remains unidentified.

title: The story of the Calvine UFO photograph
note: BBC retrospective on the 1990 Calvine photograph, the unpublished image, the MoD records and the search for the original negatives. The case remains unexplained.

title: The Bempton Mystery: Something Is Happening On The Yorkshire Coast
note: Investigation of strange lights and unexplained activity around Bempton and the Yorkshire coast, including witness accounts. Presented as an unresolved mystery; no conclusion is established.

title: FIRST SOLO WILDCAMP UK - Ilkley Moor the UK UFO Hotspot!
note: Outdoor filmmaker wild-camps on Ilkley Moor and explores the area's reputation as a UFO hotspot, including the 1987 Ilkley Moor alien photograph case. This is a location feature, not verified UAP footage.

title: Bonnybridge & Falkirk Triangle UFO Footage Compilation
note: Eyewitness video recorded in the Falkirk Triangle hotspot at Bonnybridge showing hovering amber spheres and structured nocturnal lights.

title: NPAS Police Helicopter FLIR Thermal UFO Over Bristol Channel
note: Official WESCAM MX-15 thermal infrared footage recorded by NPAS 47 police helicopter crew at 1,000 ft over the Bristol Channel, tracking a hot spherical object flying into the wind for 7 minutes.

title: Calvine Diamond UFO — Scottish MoD Case & Site Reconstruction
note: Investigation and photographic analysis of the 100-foot diamond-shaped craft photographed hovering silently near a Hawker Siddeley Harrier jet at Calvine along the A9.

title: Humber Estuary & North Lincolnshire Amber Orb Formation
note: Three glowing orange-amber spheres filmed moving in a stepped triangular formation from Scunthorpe toward the Humber Bridge before accelerating vertically.

title: Ilkley Moor & West Yorkshire Low-Altitude Disc
note: Metallic saucer-shaped object filmed hovering above the moorland ridge between Ilkley and Keighley in broad daylight.
